# Patrick Bartosik — Freelance Full Stack & AI Developer (Paris, France)

> Patrick Bartosik is a freelance Full Stack Developer based in Paris, France, with 5+ years of experience. He designs, builds, and ships production web applications (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js), Shopify Plus e-commerce, and AI features (LLM integration, autonomous agents, RAG, voice assistants). He works remotely worldwide, replies to inquiries within 24 hours, and offers a free 30-minute consultation.

## Key Facts
- Name: Patrick Bartosik
- Role: Freelance Full Stack & AI Developer
- Location: Paris, France (remote work available worldwide)
- Experience: 5+ years, 20+ projects shipped to production
- Languages: French (native), Polish (native), English (professional)
- Response time: within 24 hours; detailed proposal within 48 hours
- First consultation: free, 30 minutes, no commitment

## Process
1. Discovery — business goals, audience, constraints scoped before any code.
2. Design — UX/UI mockups and technical architecture validated together.
3. Develop — iterative sprints, regular demos, continuous Git access.
4. Deploy — testing, production rollout, monitoring, knowledge transfer.
